title: Two Sum
description: Find two numbers in array that add up to target
notes: Use hash map for O(n) time and O(n) space. Handle duplicates carefully.

title: Binary Search
description: Find target value within a sorted array
notes: Guard against integer overflow with mid = low + (high - low) / 2.

title: Reverse Linked List
description: Reverse a singly linked list in-place
notes: Iterative 3-pointer method (prev curr next) is O(1) space. Recursive approach uses call stack.

title: Valid Parentheses
description: Determine if input string of brackets is valid
notes: Use stack. Push expected matching closing bracket or match on closing.

title: Merge Intervals
description: Merge overlapping intervals into mutually exclusive intervals
notes: Sort intervals by start time first. Then compare current.start with last.end.

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
description: Traverse binary tree level by level
notes: BFS using queue. Take snapshot of queue size at start of each level loop.

title: Number of Islands
description: Count islands in a 2D binary grid
notes: DFS or BFS flood fill. Mark visited cells in-place with '0' to save space.

title: Dijkstras Algorithm
description: Find shortest paths from source vertex in weighted graph
notes: Min-heap priority queue with distance and vertex pairs.

title: LRU Cache
description: Design a Least Recently Used cache with O(1) get and put
notes: Combine Hash Map with Doubly Linked List. Dummy head and tail nodes simplify edge cases.
